title: MPTokenIssuanceSet
key_points: The MPTokenIssuanceSet transaction is used to manage MP tokens.
It allows for setting a new value, checking the current value, and resetting the value of an MP token.
The account that issued the MP token can modify its parameters.
limitations: This documentation may not cover all possible use cases or edge cases for the MPTokenIssuanceSet transaction.
asserts: The MPTokenIssuanceSet transaction enables management of MP tokens by setting, checking, and resetting their values.
scope: Describes the functionality and usage of the MPTokenIssuanceSet transaction in the XRP Ledger protocol.
